definition: a very clever and original person
description: In a grand hall with chandeliers, long tables covered in white cloth hold rows of chessboards and chess clocks. A young woman in a cream blouse and dark trousers, wearing a black blindfold, stands on the table holding up two fingers, then walks slowly along it between the boards, pointing down at them. Seated older men in jackets and jumpers stare at her in amazement, one man stands clutching his head with both hands, and a crowd of spectators watches from the back of the room.
